name: m0s_stats_branch_v1

model.name: M0S
model.encoder_and_head: frozen M0 OnlineMSTCA, same untrained anchor mapping as M0 B
model.stats_branch: on the normalized input window, per channel: mean, log(std+1e-4), min, max, log(mean|diff|+1e-4) -> 130-d; standardized with fixed mean/std fitted on 20000 fold-train windows (seed 4242), clamped to [-10,10]; Linear(130,64)-ReLU-Linear(64,128), last layer zero-initialized; output added to the 128-d encoder output before the head
model.initial_function: identical to M0 at step 0 (zero-init last layer)

training: frozen M0 B recipe: Balanced sampler formula, draws = fold-train windows, AdamW 3e-4/1e-4, batch 512, Focal gamma 2, clip 1, warmup 5 + cosine 100, best by full source val Macro-F1, early stop min30/patience20/delta0.002, seed 42

runs.fold0/fold1/fold2: train on the other two folds (fold rule of feature_groupcv_v1), predict held-out fold; comparator = M0 fold predictions from feature_groupcv_v1
runs.full: train on full train; comparator = M0 B source val predictions (secondary, val is also used for checkpoint selection)

pass_rule_on_pooled_heldout_train.a: all-normal FP lower than M0 in each of 3 folds
pass_rule_on_pooled_heldout_train.b: fault TP >= M0 TP - 0.5% of fold fault windows in each fold
pass_rule_on_pooled_heldout_train.c: independent-normal hover >30 s FP lower than M0 (pooled)
pass_rule_on_pooled_heldout_train.d: per-class fault recall drop <= 1.0 pp for each of six classes, computed on windows outside hover >30 s (pooled)
pass_rule_on_pooled_heldout_train.e: hover >30 s GPS and barometer recall reported separately, no threshold (known weak observability)
pass_rule_on_pooled_heldout_train.verdict: PASS if a, b, c, d all hold

change_from_feature_groupcv_v1: rule d excludes hover >30 s windows, decided after feature_groupcv_v1 failed rule d; feature_groupcv_v1 verdict stays FAIL
forbidden: changing branch design or rule after seeing results
